_comment: MCP servers that framecraft depends on. Add these to your Claude settings.json under mcpServers.

playwright._description: Browser automation — renders HTML scenes to screenshots/frames

ffmpeg._description: Video/audio processing — compositing, trimming, format conversion
ffmpeg._note: Pin mcp<2 — ffmpeg-mcp-lite uses mcp.server.fastmcp which was removed in mcp 2.x

edge-tts._description: Text-to-speech — Microsoft neural voices, free, no API key
edge-tts._note: Package is edge-tts-mcp (entrypoint edge_tts_mcp). Pin mcp<2 for the same reason as ffmpeg.

framecraft._description: Pipeline validator/executor — atomic render + validation fallback
framecraft._install: cd framecraft && uv sync && uv run playwright install chromium
